set.body:
Run second-level and meta-analytic models from first-level manifests without constructing a full subjects by samples GroupData matrix.

Scope:
- Add a GroupBlockSource over FirstLevelCatalog entries with exact subject or unit ordering, contrast identity, variance availability, and GroupSpace validation.
- Define scheduler-neutral group work descriptors, kernels, deterministic reducers, and transactional result sinks over spatial blocks.
- Reuse the existing group estimators and keep estimator-parity expansion in its existing bead; this slice owns scalable ingestion and execution around them.
- Reject missing maps, incompatible spaces or masks, duplicate units, and invalid variance policy through typed errors before numerical execution.

Acceptance:
- OLS and at least one variance-aware group path run from a persisted first-level catalog in bounded spatial blocks.
- Blockwise and dense reference results agree within explicit tolerances.
- Peak response payload memory scales with subjects times block size, not subjects times whole image.
- Second-level named maps and manifests preserve model, contrast, geometry, sample cohort, and first-level lineage.
set.title: Workflow group level: execute manifest-backed spatial blocks
